snippet.title: ERASURE: Visit creepy virtual worlds in this surreal horror game
snippet.description:
This is Erasure, a game where I manage scary and strange simulations in a confusing manner. Game by hologram

Links to download game:
By itself: https://hologramhologram.itch.io/erasure
Or with others as part of the Haunted PS1 Demo Disc:
https://hauntedps1.itch.io/demodisc2020
